description: This file defines an interface IConsistentRingStreamQueueMapper responsible for mapping ring ranges to stream queues in Orleans streaming infrastructure. It includes a method to retrieve queues for a given ring range.

classes.name: IConsistentRingStreamQueueMapper
classes.description: An interface for mapping ring ranges to stream queues, ensuring thread safety and extending IStreamQueueMapper.

methods.name: GetQueuesForRange
methods.description: Returns the collection of QueueId objects that correspond to the specified IRingRange.

search-terms: ring range to stream queue mapping
